title: Metropolitan taxi licence cap removed, buyback and annual licences (South Australia)
summary: South Australia's 2025 amending Act commenced on 1 July 2025 (mostly suspended) and lifted the passenger levy; from 8 December 2025 perpetual metropolitan taxi licences began to be bought back and replaced with annual licences, open to all accredited operators from 12 January 2026.

instruments.title: Passenger Transport (Point to Point Transport Services) Amendment Act 2025

commenced.what: Act commenced (most provisions suspended); levy rose from $1 to $2
Licence cancellation payments and transition to annual licences began

direction_rationale: Ending the cap on metropolitan taxi licences removes a quantity restriction on entry.
